mapper.sql: id, agent_task_id, agent_step_id, collection_plan_id, follow_up_task_id, condition_type, condition_json, current_snapshot_json, status, deadline, last_check_time, satisfied_time, check_count, version, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM assistant_agent_wait_condition WHERE agent_task_id = #{agentTaskId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM assistant_agent_wait_condition WHERE follow_up_task_id = #{followUpTaskId} AND status IN ('WAITING', 'PARTIALLY_SATISFIED', 'SATISFIED') ORDER BY id

SELECT w.id, w.agent_task_id, w.agent_step_id, w.collection_plan_id, w.follow_up_task_id, w.condition_type, w.condition_json, w.current_snapshot_json, w.status, w.deadline, w.last_check_time, w.satisfied_time, w.check_count, w.version, w.create_time, w.update_time FROM assistant_agent_wait_condition w JOIN assistant_agent_task t ON t.id = w.agent_task_id AND t.is_deleted = 0 WHERE w.status IN ('WAITING', 'PARTIALLY_SATISFIED', 'SATISFIED') AND t.status = 'WAITING_FIELD_DATA' ORDER BY COALESCE(w.last_check_time, w.create_time), w.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE assistant_agent_wait_condition SET status = 'CANCELLED', update_time = #{updateTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE agent_task_id = #{agentTaskId} AND status IN ('WAITING', 'PARTIALLY_SATISFIED', 'SATISFIED')
